pr_title: crosscluster: store LDR job IDs in table descriptor
pr_body:
This adds a new field to table descriptors that will keep track of LDR
jobs that are referencing this table as a destination.

This slice will be used in a future change to block schema changes on
this table if the slice is non-empty.

fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/129728
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/130600)
i think this will conflict slightly with https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/130592

issue_context.title: catalog: add LDRJobIDs to table descriptor with an API to add/remove them
issue_context.body:
See https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Wj-6lu7N4p3vPGJ9qDPBbu9Vu8haTpcZ4Z5cKzYTE7c/edit

Table descriptors should have a field to keep track of all the logical data replication job IDs that rely on that table.

This field will be used to restrict certain schema changes on those tables.

Epic CRDB-38974
Jira issue: CRDB-41693
